title.narrative: Strengthened institutional capacity of workers' organizations

description.narrative: In the context of ongoing political and security instability in OPT, the economic landscape and labour market face amplified risks and challenges. Recognizing the crucial role of workers’ organizations in navigating these adversities, the ILO remains committed to enhancing the institutional capacity of the Palestine General Federation of Trade Unions (PGFTU) to foster social dialogue, collective bargaining, and the enhancement of fundamental principles and rights at work. The ILO interventions under this outcome will continue its support to PGFTU to effectively engage in the implementation of the decent work program, and to influence the labour legislations, and socio-economic policies. Moreover, PGFTU and its affiliated unions will be supported to promote Fundamental Principles and Rights at Work (FPRW) and to improve its capacities and structures to better represent and defend the interests of all workers. The establishment of the Workers Protection and Advocacy Unit (WPAU) within PGFTU will fortify the union's ability to safeguard workers' rights, offer legal aid, and enhance its data management and analytical capacities.
